page.overview:
Who is "Midnight"?

"Midnight" was the nickname of a human male fighter pilot of the First Order who flew under the callsign Omega Leader and commanded Omega Squadron, At one point, "Midnight" flew above a terrestrial body and was fired upon. Midnight was equipped with a First Order pilot uniform, had fair skin and dark blonde hair.
